Voile v26.3.0-22 makes the Linux engine faster and gets more protected games past their own checks! 🛠️🎉

### Features

- Improved performance on the Linux engine. The x86 translator keeps more translated code, maps new code faster, and reuses its translations when a game writes back code it had just changed
- Improved performance in Direct3D 11 games that time their GPU work every frame
- Improved performance on the Linux engine in games that keep tens of thousands of graphics objects alive
- Improved performance on the Linux engine in protected games that often change the protection of their own code or make many invalid system calls
- Direct3D 12 games on the Linux engine preload their shaders much faster. Compiling a pipeline no longer holds back the game's other graphics calls
- Protected games now see the same process flags and segment checks as on Windows (thanks @zzoko)

### Fixes

- Fixed Direct3D 12 games on the Linux engine freezing for 5 seconds every few frames while their window has the focus
- Fixed protected games on the Linux engine freezing for up to half a minute after a while without input, then running at half their frame rate
- Fixed protected games on the Linux engine stopping themselves after a minute or two because their own integrity check ran too slowly
- Fixed protected games on the Linux engine crashing when they take the execute permission away from code the engine is translating
- Fixed some Direct3D 11 games on the Linux engine reporting that they ran out of video memory when they create shared textures with several layers

Voile v26.3.0-21 brings protected games to the Linux engine and ends loading screens that never finished! 🛠️🎉

### Features

- Games protected by an anti-tamper packer that keeps parts of their code encrypted until it runs now start and play on the Linux engine.
- Improved performance in Direct3D 12 games on the Linux engine that hand work from one GPU queue to another: a frame now waits only for that work to be sent to the GPU, not for the GPU to finish it
- WINENCPU, which limits how many processors a game sees, now also works on the Linux engine, including in the processor details games read

### Fixes

- Fixed games on the Linux engine sometimes staying forever on a loading screen: the game could miss the GPU finishing work it had just started tracking
- Fixed Direct3D 12 games on the Linux engine freezing for seconds at a time when one GPU queue waits for another
- Fixed some Direct3D 12 games on the Linux engine allocating more and more graphics memory when they only ask how large an upload is
- Fixed Windows finding no network adapter on the Linux engine, which the online services of some games ask for
- Fixed rare crashes on the Linux engine when a thread that set up its own signal stack exits

Voile v26.3.0-20 makes games on the Linux engine faster and lighter on your CPU! 🛠️🎉

### Features

- Improved performance in Direct3D 11 games on the Linux engine: most of a game's graphics queries and state checks are now answered right away, instead of waiting for the drawing already queued to finish. Games limited by the CPU get higher frame rates and use noticeably less CPU
- Improved performance on both engines in games that run lots of small background jobs: Wine now needs one request fewer to set up the signal each job uses to say it is done
- Reduced the CPU the Linux engine's graphics translation spends on every Direct3D 11 state change

### Fixes

- Fixed some games on the macOS engine slowing down over time and filling their log with millions of "node memory pool exhausted" warnings when they wait on several events at once
- Fixed some Easy Anti-Cheat splash screens on the Linux engine staying on "Initializing" forever with a CPU core at full load
- Fixed the Linux engine crashing when a game's copy protection jumps to an invalid address on purpose: the game now gets the error it expects, as on Windows

Voile v26.3.0-19 lets games on the Linux engine use your microphone, and makes them behave like Mac apps when you switch away! 🛠️🎉

### Features

- Improved performance on the Linux engine by making memory bookkeeping much cheaper: games that check their memory use often get it in microseconds instead of milliseconds, and freeing memory costs less. Every game benefits
- Games on the Linux engine can now use your Mac's microphone for in-game voice chat. macOS asks for access the first time a game opens it (Zagrios/voile-lkd#3, Zagrios/voile-wine#3, thanks @LaganYT)
- Games on the Linux engine now show their own mouse cursors instead of the Mac arrow, and can move the pointer
- Games on the Linux engine now know when you switch to another app: they pause or mute as they do on Windows, and a game that minimized itself comes back when you return to it
- Your Mac's display no longer goes to sleep while you play with a gamepad, or while a game asks to keep it on

### Fixes

- Fixed a fullscreen game on the Linux engine staying in front of the app you switched to with Cmd-Tab, or of the browser page it opened
- Fixed Caps Lock being reversed every other time in games on the Linux engine
- Fixed the numeric keypad, F13 to F20, Japanese keyboard keys and the key left of 1 on ISO keyboards not working, or giving the wrong key, in games on the Linux engine
- Fixed a game's popup windows on the Linux engine taking the focus away from the game, and windows the game brings forward staying behind
- Fixed a game on the Linux engine stopping your Mac from logging out, restarting or shutting down: the game is now asked to close
- Fixed games on the Linux engine freezing when their graphics crashed right after they read back a texture and released it, as in Fall Guys after sign-in or in busy VRChat worlds (Zagrios/neptune#1, thanks @BrandonSigil)

Voile v26.3.0-18 brings Dead by Daylight and Rocket League's Steam version to the Linux engine, and stops games freezing after a Space switch! 🛠️🎉

### Features

- Dead by Daylight now runs on the Linux engine, where its Easy Anti-Cheat works. It can still stutter at times
- Rocket League's Steam version now runs on the Linux engine too, like its Epic version

### Fixes

- Fixed games on the Linux engine, such as Rocket League, freezing for good after you switched to another Space or covered their window and then came back (Zagrios/Obelisk#14)
- Fixed Rocket League's Steam version crashing on the Linux engine about a second after the Easy Anti-Cheat splash screen (Zagrios/voile-lkd#1, thanks @jedgard25)
- Fixed games on the Linux engine crashing at start when they create more than 300 threads, as Dead by Daylight does
- Fixed the screen staying black on the Linux engine in Direct3D 11 games that change some of their render targets while keeping the others, as Dead by Daylight does
- Fixed wrong, banded colors on the Linux engine in games that draw in 10-bit color, as Dead by Daylight does

Voile v26.3.0-17 gets Windows games starting again on macOS 26, and lets games on the Linux engine open web links in your browser! 🛠️🎉

### Features

- Games on the Linux engine can now open web links in your Mac's default browser, such as the Epic sign-in page Rocket League sometimes asks you to visit
- The Linux engine now handles the system calls some protected games make directly from their Windows code, as Proton does

### Fixes

- Fixed every Windows game crashing as soon as it started on macOS 26 with the default engine
- Fixed games on the Linux engine freezing for up to a second each time they reopen their sound, as Rocket League does on some audio outputs
- Fixed a crash of the Linux engine's window server when a game recreates its display, for example when it changes resolution
